subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should the Windows Companion make OpenClaw `2026.7.2-beta.2` the default installer target before the upstream wizard-runtime correction is published in an official artifact?
rationale: The contributor explicitly presents this as a beta-target contract requiring maintainer approval, and the only successful end-to-end runs replace the exact proposed official artifact with a separate corrected core package.

options.title: Wait for a setup-proven official artifact
options.body: Keep this PR unmerged until the upstream correction is released in the selected artifact and current-head proof completes without package injection.

options.title: Split the non-default fixes
options.body: Retain the currently supported default and submit a narrow follow-up containing only independently validated formatting or Companion fixes.

options.title: Approve the beta policy explicitly
options.body: Accept the prerelease default despite the known wizard failure only with an explicit documented support and rollback policy.

recommendation.title: Wait for a setup-proven official artifact
recommendation.body: Keep this PR unmerged until the upstream correction is released in the selected artifact and current-head proof completes without package injection.
